title: Conditional flow matching in acute human wounds: analysis software and reproduction archive
description: A three-donor audit of population reconstruction by conditional flow matching in acute human wounds. The release includes the producing programs, public processed counts, frozen coordinates, saved fields and predictions, numerical evidence, protocols and corrected journal documents. It distinguishes global time holdout from donor transfer, retains adverse control comparisons and records strict replay limits. The analysis does not identify individual cell trajectories or validate clinical wound prognosis. This full reproduction archive contains the corrected inline journal manuscript, submission-layout manuscript, supplement, editable journal sources, analysis code, public processed inputs and saved research outputs. The DOI was reserved at local archive assembly; publication is a separate operation. MIT applies to authored software only. Manuscripts, figures, saved research outputs, source-study materials and third-party fonts retain the rights stated in NOTICE; the archive does not relicense those materials.
notes: Mixed-rights archive: the primary software license applies to authored software; see NOTICE and journal/source/population/fonts/ for source-data, scholarly-output and font terms.
